about.title: The back-end the money flows through, and the front-end people use to keep track of it.
about.p1: I'm a full stack developer with 4+ years building APIs and financial systems in production: billing, cost allocation and payments. My strength is the back-end, in Node.js, TypeScript, PHP/Laravel and PostgreSQL, with React and Next.js on the front-end.
about.p2: I started in IT support at UNASP-HT, looking after 6 computer labs. I joined IATec as an intern and was hired as a trainee within 8 months; then I built the billing core of an education fintech and went back to IATec as a mid-level developer on its billing systems. Today, as a freelancer, I build and run my own event website platform.
about.p3: I use AI with a method: a PRD, a glossary and ADRs before any code, and a Claude Code skill of my own in events-api. I like architecture you can verify, with Clean Architecture and DDD and the dependency rule enforced by ESLint and covered by tests. And quality in delivery: CI against a real Postgres, migration drift checks, gitleaks, and a build that fails without the OpenAPI docs. The right tool for the scale.
about.quote: The right tool for the scale.
about.availability: Open to remote roles and freelance

freelance.context: Multi-client event website platform, for weddings and birthdays.
bullets: 3 clients in production and ~200 RSVPs processed.
End to end: a React invitation with RSVP, a Hono API with Prisma, PostgreSQL and JWT, and a dashboard for clients to manage their guests.
Moved email from SQS → Lambda → SES (AWS CDK) to Resend, cutting cost and infrastructure.

iatec-mid.context: Rehired to work on the organization's billing and cost allocation systems.
bullets: Cut the main billing queries by 67% (90s → 30s) by rewriting SQL and adding indexes.
Restructured billing and PDF generation, from 5+ min to about 2 min.
Automated the export to the accounting system, with documents stored on AWS S3.
Co-built two corporate systems from conception: contract management and license distribution.
Critical APIs for the billing core of a platform used by ~15 schools (card, boleto and Pix).
Integrated 3 gateways (ASAAS, Getnet and Stone) in a microservices architecture and built the delinquency control.
Hired as a trainee within 8 months, moving on to new features in financial systems.

unasp.context: Support for the university's computer labs, on a team of three interns.
bullets: 6 labs and 300 workstations, serving ~200 students and faculty per semester.
Led lab preparation for exam periods with zero downtime.
